about: The epistle of the Third Sunday of Advent, from which the day takes its name of Gaudéte. The call to rejoice stands beside a call to modesty and to freedom from anxiety — three things Paul binds together because “the Lord is near”.

seg.tr: Brethren: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I say, rejoice.
Let your modesty be known to all people; the Lord is near.
Be anxious about nothing, but in every prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, make your petitions known to God.
And may the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus our Lord.
